label: Finite interpretations for the uniting-cause, in-act and becoming/being forks: a model in which…
paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the uniting-cause, in-act and becoming/being forks: a model in which BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_1 holds (every participated thing has another cause of its coming to be), something is participated and nothing has another cause of its being; a nonvacuity witness for the BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_2 route; per term, a model in which coverage holds and exclusivity fails, the two uses are read in different senses, every other premise of the joint theorem holds and its conclusion fails; per term, a model in which coverage fails and the rest holds with the conclusion failing; a model of the mixed in-act reading (mover formally or virtually, non-simultaneity formally) with self-motion; and a nonvacuity witness per joint theorem. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
